_description: Demo cases for the presentation and UI. Notes are synthetic (all names/IDs fictional, included on purpose to show de-identification). Images are real IU X-Ray test-split studies (by uid; run scripts/prepare_iu_xray.py first) or BiomedCLIP example images. Curated to demonstrate capabilities; NOT used in any evaluation.

cases.title: Fever, productive cough, hypoxia
cases.shows: Concordant text + image (pneumonia with effusion), NEWS2 escalation
cases.note:
ED NOTE
Patient: Deepak Malhotra, MRN AIIMS-5521098, DOB 02/07/1961, ph +91 98111 23456
64-year-old male with fever and productive cough with green sputum for 4 days. Right-sided pleuritic chest pain and shortness of breath since yesterday. No hemoptysis. No leg swelling.
Past history: type 2 diabetes mellitus.
Medications: metformin.
Vitals: Temp 38.8 C, HR 108, RR 24, BP 124/78, SpO2 90% on room air.
Plan: chest x-ray, CBC, CRP, blood culture.

cases.title: COPD flare with low oxygen
cases.shows: Emphysema on image + COPD history; NEWS2 emergency-level vitals
cases.note:
Ward admission note - Sharma, Prakash (MRN 662-118-903)
69-year-old man with COPD, ex-smoker, admitted with increased breathlessness and wheezing for 3 days. Sputum volume increased. No chest pain. No fever.
On examination: bilateral wheeze, using accessory muscles.
Vitals: RR 28, SpO2 86% on air, HR 118, BP 138/84, Temp 37.4 C.
Started nebulization with salbutamol and ipratropium.
